name: Heart of the Blight

conventions.alpha: every PNG is binary alpha (0/255) with RGB 0 under alpha 0; glow_add files are additive (black adds nothing) and must use an add blend
conventions.masters: files under _2x/ are 2x masters: draw at scale 0.5 with the same placement as the 1x file (crosshaven_art.gd prefers _2x)
conventions.grid: 64x32 diamonds; cell_to_local(x,y) = ((x-y)*32, (x+y)*16) = the diamond centre; south tip = centre + (0,16)
conventions.import: linear filter, no mipmaps, plain alpha
conventions.review_only: _mock/ has a .gdignore and is not game art

b.name: The Rotting Elder's heart chamber (boss)
b.decal_note: the root-rune circle is a walkable 5x5 floor decal. Measured on the approved boss-room design: the ring is ~3.8 tile widths across, a top-down circle of ~5.4 cells, so 5x5 (as the Abbey and Saltmaw circles). Its rings and glyph band run through the 16 border cells and the starburst sits on the centre cell. The inner 3x3 cells are the room's pads: draw the plain heart floor there (not blight_pad; the circle is the pad art) and add blight_pad_glow on those 9 cells
b.backdrop_note: the pulsing heart of the blight is painted in the back corner of the shell; pulse it in-game with a violet glow sprite if wanted (it is not a separate layer)

signature.name: Root Wall
signature.note: he lifts the staff while the crystal heart dims (f00-f02); staff high, the heart flares violet and the roots writhe at his feet (f03-f06); on f07 he drives the staff into the floor and the wall fires: spawn root_wall (rise strip) on each wall cell and draw a board/projectiles/root_crack from staff_point's floor spot to each wall cell; shockwave ripple f08-f10; he settles f11-f13. The strip name stays 'summon' (14 frames)

star5.rule: at star-5 difficulty the boss is the Crystal Colossus (replaces rotting_elder; Mauro's pick B), the Rotting Elder consumed by the blight crystal; room A's monsters may be crystal_hound and crystal_horror. The star-5 projectile is crystal_shard (+ crystal_shard_impact), the Root Wall raises crystal_wall, and the hazard is crystal_bloom (+ crystal_bloom_burst)
